# Data processing

## Library

```{r}
required <- c("readxl", "magrittr", "lubridate", "janitor", "dplyr", "skimr")
```

Installing those that are not installed yet:

```{r}
to_install <- required[!required %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
if (length(to_install))
  install.packages(to_install)
```

Loading the packages for interactive use:

```{r}
invisible(sapply(required, library, character.only = TRUE))
```

## Data importation

Set working directory and import data

```{r}
setwd("../Data")
raw_df <- read_excel("Cancer_Prevention_Awareness_Raw_Data_251203.xlsx", sheet = "DATA")
```

## Skim data

```{r}
skim(raw_df)
```


```{r}
skim(raw_df) |>
  filter(complete_rate == 1) |>
  nrow()
```

Only 187 variables have complete rate = 1

## Recoding variables

### Screening question

```{r}
raw_df %<>%
  mutate(
    gender = case_when(SQ1 == 1 ~ "Male", .default = "Female"),
    age = SQ2,
    city = case_when(
      SQ3 == 1  ~ "Seoul",
      SQ3 == 2  ~ "Busan",
      SQ3 == 3  ~ "Daegu",
      SQ3 == 4  ~ "Incheon",
      SQ3 == 5  ~ "Gwangju",
      SQ3 == 6  ~ "Daejeon",
      SQ3 == 7  ~ "Ulsan",
      SQ3 == 8  ~ "Sejong",
      SQ3 == 9  ~ "Gyeonggi",
      SQ3 == 10 ~ "Gangwon",
      SQ3 == 11 ~ "Chungcheongbuk",
      SQ3 == 12 ~ "Chungcheongnam",
      SQ3 == 13 ~ "Jeollabuk",
      SQ3 == 14 ~ "Jeollanam",
      SQ3 == 15 ~ "Gyeongsangbuk",
      SQ3 == 16 ~ "Gyeongsangnam",
      SQ3 == 17 ~ "Jeju"
    ),
    city_size = case_when(
      SQ3_1 == 1 ~ "Large City (Metropolitan)",
      SQ3_1 == 2 ~ "Medium/Small City",
      SQ3_1 == 3 ~ "County Area (including Eup/Myeon/Dong)"
    )
  )
```

### Awareness of Cancer and health determinants

```{r}
raw_df  %<>%
  mutate(
    cc_diagnosised = case_when(Q1 == 1 ~ "Self", Q1 == 2 ~ "Family", .default = "No"),
    aware_10codes = case_when(Q8 == 1 ~ "Yes (No details)", Q8 == 2 ~ "Yes (Details)", .default = "Never"),
    cc_search = case_when(Q11 == 1 ~ "Yes", .default = "No")
  )
```

### Rule 1

```{r}
raw_df %<>%
  mutate(
    ## smoking cause cancer
    cc_aw = case_when(Q13 == 1 ~ "Yes", .default = "No"),
    ## daily average cigarettes of ex-smoker
    ex_smkr_daily_avg = coalesce(Q14_2_ETC_1, 0),
    ## years of ex-smoker
    ex_smkr_years = coalesce(Q14_2_ETC_2, 0),
    ## time since quitting of ex-smoker
    ex_smkr_time_quit = coalesce(Q14_2_ETC_3, 0),
    ## daily average cigarettes of current-smoker
    cr_smkr_daily_avg = coalesce(Q14_3_ETC_1, 0),
    ## years of current-smoker
    cr_smkr_years = coalesce(Q14_3_ETC_2, 0),
    ## Have you ever attempted to quit smoking?
    attitude_to_quit = case_when(Q15 == 1 ~ "Yes", Q15 == 2 ~ "No", .default = "Not applicable"),
    ## Have you ever received education on smoking cessation? 
    smk_educated = case_when(Q19 == 1 ~ "Yes", .default = "No"),
  ) 
```

### Demographics

```{r}
raw_df %<>%
  mutate(
    marital_status = case_when(DQ2 == 1 ~ "Single", DQ2 == 2 ~ "Married", .default = "Disvorced/Separated/Widowed"),
    height = Q74,
    weight = Q75,
    education = case_when(DQ4 %in% c(1,2) ~ "Middle school or less", DQ2 == 2 ~ "High school", .default = "College or more"),
    monthly_income = case_when(DQ5 %in% c(1,2,3) ~ "<3", DQ5 %in% c(4,5,6) ~ "3-6", .default = "6 ≤")
  ) 
```

### Cancer experience

```{r}
raw_df %<>%
  mutate(
    personal_cc_exp  = 2 - DQ7_1,
    family_cc_exp    = 2 - DQ7_2,
    close_to_cc_exp  = 2 - DQ7_3,
    dont_know_cc_exp = 2 - DQ7_4
  )
```

save data

```{r}
setwd("../Data")
saveRDS(raw_df, file = "cancer_awareness_2025_processed.rds")
```
